en: Given a string n representing an integer, return the closest integer (not including itself), which is a palindrome. If there is a tie, return the smaller one.
The closest is defined as the absolute difference minimized between two integers.
examples:
Input: n = "1"
Output: "0"
Explanation: 0 and 2 are the closest palindromes but we return the smallest which is 0.
constraints: n is representing an integer in the range [1, 1018 - 1].
title: Find the Closest Palindrome
